question: Who took charge as the Director of Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __** Dr. S. Unnikrishnan Nair.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Unnikrishnan Nair,** Distinguished Scientist** took charge as Director, VSSC **( Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre) on** February 07, 2022.**
 
• He took over as the** first Director of Human Space Flight Centre, **Bengaluru in January 2019.

**The Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC):-**
